name: Campingplatz Seehamer See
beschreibung:
Situated by the idyllic Seehamer See, this campsite is superbly suited for relaxing holidays as well as comfortable transit stops on the journey towards the Alps. The grounds offer pleasant pitches, dining options, and up-to-date sanitary amenities.

The circular lakeside path and local cycling trails encourage outdoor activity, while alpine destinations remain conveniently close.
kurzbeschreibung: Campingplatz Seehamer See features convenient access, lakeside charm, and ideal stopover facilities on the way south.
